method:
Order of judgement as the sources give it. (1) Frame: day stem is the self, year the root, month the sprout and outline (提綱), day the flower, hour the fruit (淵海子平 論日為主). (2) Month branch first: the day master's season and state (得令; 三命通會 卷二 旺相休囚死). (3) Roots in branches and hidden stems plus stem support decide strong or weak (旺則宜洩宜傷，衰則喜幫喜助). (4) Favourable and unfavourable elements by balance (扶抑); 調候, 通關, 格局 and 從格 are separate NAMED CONVENTIONS, not mixed. (5) Read ten gods by topic (six-kin, palaces, sex). (6) Judge the luck pillar (read from its branch: 大運看支), then the year (read from its stem: 歲君看干), with 蓋頭/截腳 as a multiplier applied in ONE place (bazi.cover-cut). (7) Check the incoming branch against natal branches (clash, combination) and the tabled stars as modifiers. The month-structure (格局) route of 子平真詮 is a recorded variant only; the day-master balance order is used because the engine can compute it. Numbers (strength score, 0.6/0.4 weights, 5/10/30/40/45/55 thresholds) are modern conventions, labelled as such; no source gives a number.

ENGINE RULES FROM THE CHECKER (applied): (a) one scoring path per fact: 'general' for a period = fav() of the pillar (luck-pillar-judgement, year-judgement); each topic = the topic's ten-god family x fav() (the *-in-luck rules); the two paths never both fire for the same topic and span. (b) One relation table (clash, combination, harm, punishment) plus one palace table assign topic; the palace rules do not fire separately. (c) Main qi is taken from the engine's main/middle/residual hidden stems, never from verse order. (d) Fixed-sign rules were made conditional where the sources say judge by 喜忌. (e) Rules sharing a physical fact carry a dedupeKey (see rules).

topicDefinitions.definition: In this tradition wealth is the 財 star (the element the day master overcomes), read for its root and for the day master's ability to carry it, with 食傷 as its source and 比劫 as its rival. A year or luck pillar that brings a supported 財 in a favourable element is a money period.
topicDefinitions.significators: 正財 and 偏財 (stems and hidden stems); 食神 and 傷官 as the source of 財; 比肩 and 劫財 as what takes it; the luck pillar and year branch/stem as 財; 祿神 and 天乙貴人 as help.
topicDefinitions.source: 淵海子平 論日為主 (財 is the second of five categories), 論正財, 論偏財; 滴天髓輯要 六親論 (大率依財看妻, 財旺身弱喜比劫)

topicDefinitions.definition: Career is the 官殺 star (the element that overcomes the day master): rank, office and authority. It is judged for being single, clear and rooted, for being supported by 財, and for being controlled by 食傷 or converted by 印 when it is too strong. Mixed 官 and 殺 (官殺混雜) is the main flag; the sources do not give it a fixed sign.
topicDefinitions.significators: 正官, 七殺 (stems and hidden stems); 財 as source; 印 as converter; 食傷 as suppressor; the month branch as the 'outline'; the luck pillar and year as 官殺 in a favourable or unfavourable element.
topicDefinitions.source: 淵海子平 論正官, 論七殺, 論官殺混雜要制伏; 滴天髓闡微 官殺 (二十一)

topicDefinitions.definition: For a man the spouse star is 財 (正財 wife, 偏財 secondary partner). For a woman it is 官殺 (正官 or 七殺 as husband). The day branch is the spouse palace for both sexes. Peers and siblings are 比劫. Children are a woman's 傷官 (son) and 食神 (daughter) in 淵海子平; the man's half is not verified. Relationships is convention-dependent: the spouse star depends on the sex convention chosen.
topicDefinitions.significators: Man: 財 stars, day branch. Woman: 官殺 stars, day branch. 比劫 for siblings and rivals, 桃花/咸池 as modifier.
topicDefinitions.source: 淵海子平 論妻妾, 論子息, 論婦人總訣, 論兄弟姊妹; 滴天髓輯要 六親論

topicDefinitions.definition: The tradition's health reading is element balance. An element that is excessive or cut off (死絕) strains the organ of that element, and a disliked element that is neither checked nor transformed strikes the organ it overcomes. A tendency by organ system; no diagnostic claim.
topicDefinitions.significators: The five element counts, the unfavourable (忌神) element and the organ it attacks, 刑 striking the day and hour pillars, the stem-to-organ table.
topicDefinitions.source: 滴天髓輯要 疾病論 (attack chain verified in 滴天髓闡微); stem-organ verse in 淵海子平

topicDefinitions.definition: Learning is the 印 star (生我: resource, mother, teacher, certificates) with 食神 as expression. A 印 that is rooted and not broken by 財 gives study and support. 學堂 and 文昌 add to it; the 文昌 table is held back as unverified.
topicDefinitions.significators: 正印 and 偏印; 食神; 學堂 (derived convention from the day master's 長生 branch, see rule).
topicDefinitions.source: 淵海子平 論印綬; 三命通會 卷三 論學堂詞館

topicDefinitions.definition: Movement and residence: 驛馬 (post-horse branch) and clash of the branches that stand for the home. A 驛馬 year signals relocation or travel, with no verdict until the favourable-element test is applied. The mapping of pillars to residence is a later convention.
topicDefinitions.significators: 驛馬 by the year or day branch's three-harmony group, 六沖 to the month or day branch.
topicDefinitions.source: 三命通會 卷三 論驛馬, 卷二 論衝擊; residence mapping is a modern convention built on 淵海子平 論月令

topicDefinitions.definition: The overall quality of a period: the day master's balance after the luck pillar and the year are added, tested by whether the pillar's elements are favourable (喜) or unfavourable (忌) and whether the pillar clashes with the natal chart.
topicDefinitions.significators: Favourable-element membership of the pillar's stem and branch, 蓋頭/截腳, 天剋地沖, 歲運並臨, 伏吟/反吟.
topicDefinitions.source: 滴天髓闡微 歲運 (二十八); 三命通會 卷二 總論歲運; 淵海子平 論大運

conventionsToExpose: yin-stem 長生 runs backward (convention, not seen in text)
earth 旺 in all four 季月 (common practice; source says only 六月)

hiddenStems.note: Set of hidden stems from the 淵海子平 verse 又地支藏遁歌 (verified). The verse order is NOT main-qi order. Main qi (checker, 丑辰巳未戌) listed first in 'mainFirst'; the other seven branches are single-main or first-listed = main. Use the engine's own main/middle/residual in code; this table is the cross-check.

tables.elements: 甲乙 wood, 丙丁 fire, 戊己 earth, 庚辛 metal, 壬癸 water; 寅卯 wood, 巳午 fire, 申酉 metal, 亥子 water, 辰戌丑未 earth. Odd stems yang (甲丙戊庚壬), even yin; branches 子寅辰午申戌 yang, 丑卯巳未酉亥 yin.
tables.tenGods: Day stem D, other stem X: same element same polarity 比肩, opposite 劫財. D generates X: same 食神, opposite 傷官. D overcomes X: same 偏財, opposite 正財. X overcomes D: same 七殺, opposite 正官. X generates D: same 偏印, opposite 正印. Check (淵海子平): for 甲, 庚辛 are 官殺, 戊己 財, 壬癸 印, 丙丁 食傷, 甲乙 劫財/比肩.
tables.generateOvercome: Generate: wood > fire > earth > metal > water > wood. Overcome: wood earth, earth water, water fire, fire metal, metal wood.
tables.wangXiangXiuQiuSi: day-master element e, month element m: e=m 旺; m generates e 相; e generates m 休; e overcomes m 囚; m overcomes e 死 (三命通會 卷二).

twelveStages.sequence: 長生, 沐浴, 冠帶, 臨官, 帝旺, 衰, 病, 死, 墓, 絕, 胎, 養

changSheng.戊: 寅 (fire-earth school) or 申 (water-earth school, 三命通會 卷三)
changSheng.己: 酉 (fire-earth school) or 卯 (water-earth school)

twelveStages.classes: 四貴 = 胎 生 旺 庫(墓); 四忌 = 死 絕 病 敗(沐浴); the rest 四平 (三命通會 卷二). Yang stems run forward, yin backward: convention, not seen in the text.

tables.sixClashes: 子午 丑未 寅申 卯酉 辰戌 巳亥
tables.sixCombinations: 子丑 寅亥 卯戌 辰酉 巳申 午未 (pairs only; the 合化 elements are held back)
tables.threeHarmony: 申子辰 水, 亥卯未 木, 寅午戌 火, 巳酉丑 金 (三命通會 卷二: a group missing one character does not transform)
tables.stemCombinations: 甲己 乙庚 丙辛 丁壬 戊癸
tables.stemOppositions: stems 4 or 6 apart in the ten-stem cycle (甲庚 乙辛 丙壬 丁癸 戊甲 己乙 庚丙 辛丁 壬戊 癸己), symmetric
tables.voidBranches: 甲子旬 戌亥; 甲戌旬 申酉; 甲申旬 午未; 甲午旬 辰巳; 甲辰旬 寅卯; 甲寅旬 子丑 (verified)
tables.stemToOrgan: 甲膽 乙肝 丙小腸 丁心 戊胃 己脾 庚大腸 辛肺 壬膀胱 癸腎 (verse in 淵海子平 text read by the checker)
tables.uncheckedDislikedElementAttacks: wood->earth 脾; fire->metal 肺; earth->water 腎; metal->wood 肝; water->fire 心 (滴天髓闡微, verified)

coverCutByWantedElement.note: Lists from 滴天髓闡微 歲運, keyed by the element the chart wants. The same pillar can appear under two wanted elements. The engine implements the relation (蓋頭: stem overcomes branch element; 截腳: branch overcomes stem element or fails to generate it) and uses these lists as test cases. One earth 截腳 entry printed 乙卯 where the sense is 己卯: held back, not emended.

gaiTou.earth: 甲戌 甲辰 乙丑 乙未

jieJiao.wood: 甲申 乙酉 乙丑 乙巳
jieJiao.fire: 丙子 丁丑 丙申 丁酉 丁亥
jieJiao.earth: 戊寅 戊子 己酉 戊申
jieJiao.metal: 庚午 辛亥 庚寅 辛卯 庚子
jieJiao.water: 壬寅 癸卯 壬午 癸未 壬辰 癸巳

tables.strengthScoreConvention: MINE (modern): month branch main-qi weight 3.0, day branch 1.5, year and hour branches 1.0 (second hidden stem 0.5x, third 0.25x of the branch weight), each other stem 1.0. NO further multiplier for 旺相/囚死 (counted once, by the 3.0 month weight). Support = 比劫 + 印. Strong S > 55, weak S < 45, balanced 45 <= S <= 55.

rules.name: Day master's state in the month (旺相休囚死)
rules.condition: Let e = element of the day stem and m = element of the month branch (寅卯 wood, 巳午 fire, 申酉 metal, 亥子 water, 辰戌丑未 earth). If e = m the state is 旺. If m generates e: 相. If e generates m: 休. If e overcomes m: 囚. If m overcomes e: 死. The first two are 得令 (in season); the other three are 失令. Output is an input to the strength score, not a verdict.
rules.template: The day master {dayStem} is {state} in the {monthBranch} month ({deLing}).
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷二 論五行旺相休囚死並寄生十二宮 (萬民英)
rules.sourceLocator: 卷二, section 論五行旺相休囚死並寄生十二宮
rules.sourceQuote: 盛德乘時曰旺。如春木旺，旺則生火，火乃木之子，子乘父業，故火相；木用水生
rules.variants: The source states only six-month earth (六月土旺). Common practice makes earth 旺 in all four 季月 (named convention). 滴天髓闡微 (衰旺) warns that '得時俱為旺論，失令便作衰看' is a dead rule because out-of-season elements keep residual qi.

rules.name: Twelve stages of the day master in each branch
rules.condition: For each natal branch B find the stage of the day stem in B from the 長生 table (tables.twelveStages): forward for yang stems, backward for yin stems (yin reversal is a named convention, not seen in the text). Classify by the source's own classes: 四貴 = 胎, 長生, 帝旺, 墓(庫); 四忌 = 死, 絕, 病, 沐浴(敗); all others 四平. The stage is a WEIGHT only. Root is decided once, by bazi.hidden-stems; the stage must not be added as a second root test. 戊 and 己 長生 follow the school chosen (fire-earth: 戊寅, 己酉; water-earth: 戊申, 己卯).
rules.template: The day master sits in {stage} ({class}) in the {pillarName} branch ({branch}).
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷二 論五行旺相休囚死並寄生十二宮; the water-earth 長生 (水土長生申，臨官亥) in 卷三 論學堂詞館
rules.sourceLocator: 卷二 same section; 卷三 論學堂詞館
rules.sourceQuote: 古以胎生旺庫為四貴，死絕病敗為四忌，余為四平，亦大概言之。
rules.variants: Earth follows fire (戊 寅) in one school and water (戊 申, 己 卯) in another. Yin-stem reverse run is a convention. 滴天髓闡微 (衰旺): 長生 and 祿 are weaker than an actual root, so use the stage only as a weight.
rules.verificationNote: Classification completed (沐浴 in 四忌, 胎 in 四貴, 養 not rooted); 己 water-earth 長生 corrected to 卯; yin reversal marked convention; double root removed.

rules.name: Hidden stems (人元) of each branch, for roots and ten gods
rules.condition: Expand each branch into its hidden stems (tables.hiddenStems.verseSet). Weight them by the engine's main/middle/residual qi, NOT by verse order (main qi: 丑 己, 辰 戊, 巳 丙, 未 己, 戌 戊; others as listed). A hidden stem that equals or generates the day stem's element is a root (得地). Compute each hidden stem's ten god from the day stem. This is the only root test; bazi.twelve-stages and bazi.strength-score read it.
rules.template: The {pillarName} branch {branch} hides {hiddenList}, giving the day master a root through {rootStems}.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論天干地支暗藏總訣, 又地支藏遁歌
rules.sourceLocator: opening section of 淵海子平 on wikisource, 又地支藏遁歌
rules.sourceQuote: 子宮癸水在其中，丑癸辛金己土同；寅宮甲木兼丙戊，卯宮乙木獨相逢。
rules.variants: The verse lists 巳 as 庚丙戊; many modern tables list 丙庚戊. The paired 論天干地支暗藏總訣 gives days of command (人元司令) per hidden stem; that day-count version is a variant for the month-state test and is not in the table.
rules.verificationNote: Label 'main first' in the original was false for 丑 辰 巳 未 戌; main qi corrected.

rules.name: Day-master strength score (得令, 得地, 得勢)
rules.condition: MODERN CONVENTION; no source gives a number. S = 100 * support / (support + drain). Each of the other seven characters adds its weight to support if its ten god is 比肩, 劫財, 正印 or 偏印, else to drain. Weights (tables.strengthScoreConvention): month branch main qi 3.0, day branch 1.5, year and hour branches 1.0, second hidden stem 0.5x and third 0.25x the branch weight, each other stem 1.0, main qi from the engine. 得令 is counted once through the 3.0 month weight; there is NO extra 1.25/0.75 multiplier. Class: S > 55 strong, S < 45 weak, 45 <= S <= 55 balanced. Follower flag (從格 candidate, flag only, no verdict): no branch hides a stem of 比劫 or 印 element and S < 20.
rules.template: Day-master strength score {S} ({class}); 得令 {deLing}, 得地 roots {roots}, 得勢 stem support {stemSupport}.
rules.sourceCitation: 滴天髓闡微 衰旺 (任鐵樵); 淵海子平 論日為主
rules.sourceLocator: 滴天髓闡微 十七、衰旺; 淵海子平 論日為主 'or strong or weak'
rules.sourceQuote: 旺則宜洩宜傷，衰則喜幫喜助，子平之理也
rules.variants: Weights and thresholds are mine. Schools differ widely on how much 得令 outweighs 得地 and 得勢. 滴天髓: in the strong there is weakness that must not be cut, in the weak strength that must not be added to. The thresholds are exposed as a named convention.
rules.verificationNote: Strict inequalities (bands no longer overlap); 得令 no longer double counted; main-qi order fixed; follower flag defined by hidden-stem root.

rules.name: Favourable and unfavourable elements by the balance method (扶抑)
rules.condition: From the strength class: strong -> favourable (喜用) are the elements of 食傷, 財 and 官殺; unfavourable (忌) those of 印 and 比劫. Weak -> favourable 印 and 比劫; unfavourable 食傷, 財, 官殺. Balanced -> NO favourable set; fav() returns 0 for every element, and the output must say 'balanced: no favourite chosen, period signs from fav() are silent'. The ranking-within-set clause of the original is dropped (not programmable). Store the pair (favourable, unfavourable) as the input of every period rule. 調候, 通關, 格局 and 從格 are separate selectable conventions; only 扶抑 and 通關 are available (調候 table held back).
rules.template: For this {strengthClass} day master the favourable elements are {favourable} and the unfavourable are {unfavourable}.
rules.sourceCitation: 滴天髓闡微 衰旺 (原註 and 任氏曰); 淵海子平 大運 section
rules.sourceLocator: 滴天髓闡微 十七、衰旺; 淵海子平 論大運 'strong stem suits weak luck, weak stem suits strong luck'
rules.sourceQuote: 干旺宜行衰運，干弱宜旺運
rules.variants: (1) 調候 (窮通寶鑑): temperature first; table held back. (2) 通關 per bazi.tongguan. (3) 格局 school (子平真詮): favourable god from the month structure, no strength count first. (4) 從格: with no root the favourites flip to follow the dominant force. Expose each as a named convention.
rules.verificationNote: Ranking clause dropped; balanced case made explicit.

rules.name: Mediating element (通關) for two opposed strong forces
rules.condition: Variant overlay. Let X overcome Y with each combined weight >= 30% of all weight and the element Z that X generates and that generates Y below 10%. Then Z is the 通關 element and is added to the favourable set under the 通關 convention. Z: wood-earth fire; fire-metal earth; earth-water metal; metal-wood water; water-fire wood. 30% and 10% are mine, not the source's.
rules.template: {X} and {Y} are locked against each other and {Z} would connect them.
rules.sourceCitation: 滴天髓闡微 通關 (二十)
rules.sourceLocator: 十八-二十 section 通關 原註
rules.sourceQuote: 木土而要火，火金而要土，土水而要金，金林而要水
rules.variants: The 30% and 10% thresholds are mine. The wikisource text has a miscopy, 金林 for 金木; the quote is exact to the page.

rules.name: Natal promise of wealth
rules.condition: Let W = the 財 stars (正財, 偏財) among stems and hidden stems. Apply in this precedence, first match wins: (d) 'absent' if no 財 appears in stems or hidden stems (neutral); (c) 'too heavy' if W weight > 1.5 x day-master support (財多身弱; unfavourable); (b) 'robbed' if 比劫 weight exceeds W weight and no 官殺 or 食傷 checks it (unfavourable; this is the ONLY place peer-against-wealth is scored natally); (a) 'present and carried' if W has a root or shows on a stem and the day master is strong, or weak with 印 or 比劫 present (favourable). 食傷 strengthens (a). Thresholds are mine.
rules.template: Wealth promise is {grade}: 財 stars {wealthList}, day master {strengthClass}.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論正財, 論妻妾; 滴天髓輯要 六親論
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論正財 (end), 論妻妾; 滴天髓輯要 六親論 原註
rules.variants: 淵海子平 holds that 財 delights in 印綬; 子平真詮 holds 印 and 財 attack each other: opposite ratings for a chart with both, a known school difference. In 滴天髓 the 財 is judged as one of the liked spirits (喜神). Sections cited are real; the line 財多身弱，妻反勝夫 was not found by the checker, so no quote is shown.
rules.verificationNote: Precedence added so grades are exclusive; (b) not duplicated in bazi.peers-rivals; unverified quote removed.

rules.name: Natal promise of career (官殺)
rules.condition: Let O = the 正官 and 七殺 stars. Apply in precedence, first match wins: (e) 'overpowering' if O weight >= 2 x day-master support and no 印 or 食傷 (unfavourable); (d) 'weak or absent' if no 官殺 has a root or the month branch holds none (neutral); (b) 'mixed' (官殺混雜) if both 正官 and 七殺 appear with neither 食傷 to remove 殺 nor a stem combination removing one: FLAG ONLY, no sign (direction activates; the sources say mixing is sometimes acceptable); (c) 'controlled' if 七殺 is present with 食神 or 印 beside it (favourable); (a) 'clear officer' if exactly one of 正官 or 七殺 shows on a stem, rooted, and the day master is strong or has 印 (favourable). Main qi from the engine.
rules.template: Career promise is {grade}: 官殺 {officerList}, {mixedNote}.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論七殺, 論官殺混雜要制伏; 滴天髓闡微 官殺 (二十一)
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論七殺 and 論官殺混雜要制伏; 滴天髓闡微 二十一、官殺 原註
rules.sourceQuote: 殺即官也，同流共派者可混也；官非殺也，各立門牆者，不可混也。
rules.variants: 淵海子平 holds 官殺混雜 must be controlled (制伏). 滴天髓 says mixing is sometimes acceptable and 任鐵樵 gives cases: a strong self treats 殺 as 官, a weak self treats 官 as 殺. 子平真詮: mixing breaks a structure unless one is combined away.
rules.verificationNote: Exclusive precedence; mixed is a flag, not a negative verdict.

rules.name: Spouse promise for a man (財 star and day/month branch)
rules.condition: Male-chart convention only (sex input is a named 'spouse star convention'). Wife stars = 正財 (wife), 偏財 (secondary). Grade, first match wins: (d) 'absent' if no 財 shows; (c) 'burdened' if 財 weight > 1.5 x day-master support; (b) 'rivalled' if 比劫 weight exceeds 財 weight and no 官殺 or 食傷 checks it; (a) 'supported' if a 財 star has a root and the day branch OR month branch has a main qi (engine) of 財 or 官 (source: seated on 財官 under day and month). Also record 'day branch in 空亡'. Thresholds mine.
rules.template: Spouse star for a man is {grade}: 財 {wealthList}; day branch {dayBranch} {kongwangNote}.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論妻妾; 滴天髓輯要 六親論 夫妻
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論妻妾; 滴天髓輯要 六親論, first couplet
rules.sourceQuote: 正財為正妻，偏財妾也。
rules.variants: 滴天髓: rely on 財 to see the wife. 任鐵樵 objects to father-as-財. 淵海子平 gives a harsher loss-of-wife list (日坐空亡 難為妻妾), kept as flagged conditions only.
rules.verificationNote: Main-qi fix; month branch added as the source states; thresholds marked mine.

rules.name: Spouse promise for a woman (官殺 star and day branch)
rules.condition: Female-chart convention only. Husband stars = 正官, 七殺. Grade: (a) 'single clear' if exactly one of 正官 or 七殺 appears and is rooted (七殺正官，只要一位者良); (b) 'mixed' if both appear, or three or more 官殺 characters appear (殺多則夫多); (c) 'injured' if 傷官 appears beside 正官 (傷官見官) with no 印 to check it; (d) 'absent' if neither appears, or 官殺 shows only on a stem with no root. Also record 'day branch in 空亡'. Same fact as bazi.topic-career-promise (b) for the same woman: dedupeKey shared, label once.
rules.template: Husband star for a woman is {grade}: 官殺 {officerList}; 傷官 {hurtingOfficerNote}.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論婦人總訣; 滴天髓輯要 六親論 女命
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論婦人總訣 (opening lines and 傷官 lines); 滴天髓輯要 六親論, 女命須要論安詳
rules.sourceQuote: 取官為夫，為福星；財旺生官，則夫納福。
rules.variants: 滴天髓: a woman whose 官星 is too strong takes 傷 as husband, with too little takes 財; 淵海子平 reads 傷官見官 as harming the husband, later schools say it depends on 印 or 財. Moral language about 'licentious' charts is not reproduced.

rules.name: Children promise (woman's half only)
rules.condition: Female chart only: 傷官 is the son and 食神 the daughter. Grade: 'supported' if the child star is rooted, appears on a stem or in the hour branch, and is not struck by 偏印 or 印; 'thin' if absent from stems and hidden stems. The man's half (七殺 son, 正官 daughter) is held back (not seen in the text). The 'broken' conditions (時沖, 空亡 on the hour pillar) are the researcher's own, not in the quoted line: they are kept as flags only, no sign.
rules.template: Children promise is {grade}: child star {starList} on the {pillarName} pillar.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論子息; 滴天髓輯要 六親論 子女
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論子息 (opening and 女命取傷官是子 lines); 滴天髓輯要 六親論, second couplet
rules.sourceQuote: 女命取傷官是子，食神是女；若見印綬梟神，難得子也。
rules.variants: 滴天髓: rely on 官星 for children; for a woman 食神 clear is a noble child. 任鐵樵 objects to taking 官 as child. The child-count rules (一殺一子) are excluded as number claims. Topic bucket 'relationships' is a convention, the source does not assign one.
rules.verificationNote: Restricted to the verified woman's half; unverified conditions made flags.

rules.name: Natal promise of learning (印, 學堂)
rules.condition: Let Y = 正印 and 偏印 stars. Grade: (a) 'supported' if a 正印 has a root, is not struck by an unchecked 財, and the day master is not already strong; (b) 'excess' if 印 weight > 1.5 x the rest and the day master is strong; (d) 'absent'. The 倒食 clause is removed (not confirmed, and 倒食 may not be 偏印 only). Flag 'academy' if the day master's 長生 branch (derived convention: the source keys 學堂 on the 納音 of the 命, e.g. 金命 見辛巳, which the engine cannot compute) appears in the natal branches unclashed and not 空亡; 詞館 = the 臨官 branch.
rules.template: Learning promise is {grade}: 印 {resourceList}; academy flag {academy} (derived convention).
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論印綬, 論倒食, 論日為主; 三命通會 卷三 論學堂詞館
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論印綬, 論倒食; 三命通會 卷三 論學堂詞館
rules.sourceQuote: 長生乃學堂之正位，如金命見辛巳，金長生在巳；辛巳，納音又屬金是也。
rules.variants: 三命通會 gives several 學堂 definitions including 學堂會祿 (金長生巳，臨官申，甲乙人得之). 滴天髓 treats 印 as liked only when the self is weak. Day-stem 長生 is a derived convention, not what the quote says.
rules.verificationNote: 學堂 relabelled as derived convention; 倒食 clause removed.

rules.name: Health tendency by element balance
rules.condition: Count element weights across the pillars. (a) For each unfavourable (忌) element X with no element in the chart that overcomes it, record the organ X attacks (tables.uncheckedDislikedElementAttacks). (b) For each element with weight < 5% and no hidden-stem root (死絕), record its organ as deficient: 腎 water, 心 fire, 肝 wood, 肺 metal, 脾 earth. (c) 'harmonious' if no element is < 5% or > 40% and no unfavourable element is unchecked. Direction unfavourable for (a), (b); favourable for (c). 5% and 40% are mine. A tendency only.
rules.template: Health tendency: {organList} flagged because {reason}.
rules.sourceCitation: 滴天髓輯要 疾病論 (attack chain verified in 滴天髓闡微); stem-organ verse in 淵海子平 (the researcher cited 三命通會 卷七, which the checker did not find)
rules.sourceLocator: 滴天髓輯要 疾病論 (忌神入五臟而病凶); stem-organ verse in the 淵海子平 text read by the checker
rules.sourceQuote: 忌木而入土者脾病，忌火而入金則肺病，忌土而入水則腎病，忌金而入木則肝病，忌水而入火則心病。
rules.variants: 滴天髓 also gives 'visiting' 客神 and the 六經. Health and relationship verdicts are not independent in the source ('the disease may take its place').
rules.verificationNote: Stem-organ citation corrected; 'unchecked' defined; bounds marked mine.

rules.name: What each natal pillar stands for (the palace table)
rules.condition: The single palace table used by every incoming-branch rule. Year pillar: root, ancestors, early years. Month pillar: the outline, parents. Day stem: self; day branch: spouse palace (attested via 日下月下坐財官, 日坐空亡). Hour pillar: children, subordinates, late years. Topic assignment of an incoming relation by struck palace: year branch -> home-travel, general; month branch -> career, home-travel; day branch -> relationships, health; hour branch -> relationships, career. Only 'year = ancestors, month = parents, day branch = spouse, hour = children' are attested; mapping year to residence, month to career/home, and the age bands are LATER CONVENTIONS and are labelled so in output. This rule never fires on its own; it routes the topic of bazi.branch-chong, bazi.branch-liuhe and the other relation rules.
rules.template: The incoming {branch} strikes the {pillarName} palace ({palaceMeaning}).
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論日為主, 論月令, 論妻妾, 論子息; 三命通會 卷二 論衝擊
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論日為主 (年為根…時為果); 論月令; 論妻妾 (日下月下坐財官); 三命通會 卷二 論衝擊 (月沖日時，時沖年)
rules.sourceQuote: 以日為主，年為本，月為提綱，時為輔佐。
rules.variants: The year-to-residence and month-to-career/home mappings are later conventions; 淵海子平 only names year as ancestors and month as parents.
rules.verificationNote: Attested versus conventional mappings separated; made the single router.

rules.name: Ten gods and their signification
rules.condition: Ten god of any stem X against day stem D by element relation and polarity (tables.tenGods). Signification: 財 = wealth (and wife for a man); 官殺 = career and rank (husband for a woman); 印 = learning, support; 食傷 = output, skill (and children for a woman); 比劫 = peers, siblings, rivals, what competes for 財. Kin claims (father 偏財, mother 正印, 傷官 as grandchild, 倒食 = 偏印) were not seen by the checker and are NOT part of this rule; keep kin assignments separate from topic assignments.
rules.template: {stem} is {tenGod} to the {dayStem} day master, so it stands for {topicMeaning}.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論日為主 (five categories); 論妻妾, 論子息, 論父, 論母, 論兄弟姊妹
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論日為主 (一曰官 ... 五曰同類); 論父; 論母
rules.sourceQuote: 二曰財，分之陰陽，曰正財、偏財，甲乙見戊己也
rules.variants: 淵海子平 treats 傷官 as a grandchild star in its six-kin list while 滴天髓 and later texts treat it as a child star for a woman. 任鐵樵 rejects 財 as father and 官 as child. Naming of 偏印 = 倒食 = 梟 differs by author.
rules.verificationNote: Derivation confirmed; unseen kin claims dropped from the condition.

rules.name: Peers and siblings (比劫)
rules.condition: Let B = 比肩 and 劫財 stars. 'peer help' if B has a root and the day master is weak. 'strong peers' if B weight >= 40% of the chart (mine). Rivalry for wealth is NOT scored here (owned by bazi.topic-wealth-promise (b)). The sibling mapping (比肩 brother, 劫財 sister) was not confirmed and is not used.
rules.template: Peers are {helpOrStrong}: 比劫 weight {weight}.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論兄弟姊妹, 論劫財; 滴天髓輯要 六親論
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論兄弟姊妹 and 論劫財; 滴天髓輯要 六親論, third and fourth couplets
rules.sourceQuote: 甲木旺相，兄姊爭財；甲乙寅卯既多，則兄弟姊妹奪財不和
rules.variants: 滴天髓 adds that 比劫 with a strong 官 or 財 assists the master (助主之功), so rivalry or help depends on whether 財官 is strong or weak.
rules.verificationNote: Duplicate wealth rivalry removed; unconfirmed sibling mapping removed.

rules.name: Void (空亡) branches
rules.condition: From the day pillar's 旬 the two unused branches are the 空亡 pair (tables.voidBranches). Any natal, luck or year branch equal to a day-pillar 空亡 branch is flagged 'void'. Year pillar's 旬 is a secondary variant. The text says 'void, but there is substance' so a void flag alone is not read as bad.
rules.template: {branch} is void (空亡) for the {dayPillar} day, so the {palace} palace is empty.
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷三 論空亡
rules.sourceLocator: 卷三, 論空亡
rules.sourceQuote: 故以甲旬盡處曰空亡，蓋有是位而無祿，曰空；有支而無干，曰亡。
rules.variants: 三命通會 reports a 珞琭子 variant taking the void from the year pillar and a 五陽令用一陽，五陰令用一陰 variant. The modern standard uses the day pillar's 旬.

rules.name: Judging a luck pillar (大運), general topic
rules.condition: 'general' topic only (topic readings are owned by the *-in-luck rules). Luck pillar stem S, branch B. fav(x) = +1 favourable element, -1 unfavourable, 0 otherwise (bazi.favourable-fuyi; balanced gives 0). Luck score L = 0.6 * fav(B element, main qi) + 0.4 * fav(S element). Weights are a named convention (滴天髓 reads luck by the branch, 大運看支). L >= 0.5 good; -0.5 < L < 0.5 mixed; L <= -0.5 bad. The 蓋頭/截腳 multiplier is applied ONLY by bazi.cover-cut, not here. The 'hidden stems at 0.2 each' addition is dropped (undefined). 任氏 forbids cutting a luck into upper and lower halves; the stem/branch split is therefore a convention to expose.
rules.template: The luck pillar {pillar} ({tenGodStem}/{tenGodBranch}) is {grade} for this chart: the branch is {branchFav}, the stem {stemFav}.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論大運; 滴天髓闡微 歲運 (二十八); 滴天髓輯要 歲運論
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論大運; 滴天髓闡微 二十八、歲運; 滴天髓輯要 歲運論
rules.sourceQuote: 子平之法，大運看支，歲君看干，交運同接木。
rules.variants: 任鐵樵: 一運看十年切勿上下截看. 淵海子平 adds a school reading from the month branch (今運就月上起) and the structure's 用神. The modern 'stem first five years, branch last five' split is not in the sources and is excluded. Luck-by-ten-god lists are called dead methods by the source, to be read by 喜忌.
rules.verificationNote: Restricted to general; duplicated halving removed; undefined hidden-stem term dropped.

rules.name: 蓋頭 and 截腳 of a luck pillar (the only place the halving is applied)
rules.condition: For a luck pillar stem S, branch B and a wanted element E (from bazi.favourable-fuyi). 蓋頭: S overcomes the element of B. 截腳: B overcomes the element of S or fails to generate it. If the wanted element is on the stem and the branch cuts it, or on the branch and the stem caps it, the force is halved (multiplier 0.5 on that pillar's fav contribution). If the natal stems already hold a remedy (a stem that overcomes the cutting stem or drains it) the loss is halved again. Implement by relation; the by-wanted-element lists (tables.coverCutByWantedElement) are test cases, because one pillar can be 蓋頭 for one wanted element and 截腳 for another.
rules.template: {pillar} is {capOrCut}: the {favouredHalf} is weakened by the {hostileHalf}.
rules.sourceCitation: 滴天髓闡微 歲運 (二十八)
rules.sourceLocator: 二十八、歲運, 任氏曰 paragraphs defining 何謂蓋頭 and 何謂截腳
rules.sourceQuote: 何謂蓋頭？如喜木運而遇庚寅辛卯，喜火運而遇壬午癸巳
rules.variants: 任氏: a stem generating a branch is better than a branch generating a stem (寧使天干生地支). Schools that read a luck as a unit discard this rule.
rules.verificationNote: Lists keyed by wanted element; metal and water 截腳 lists added from the text; 戊申 added; the ambiguous 乙卯/己卯 entry held back.

rules.name: Judging an annual pillar (流年), general topic
rules.condition: 'general' topic only. Year stem S, branch B. Y = 0.6 * fav(S element) + 0.4 * fav(B element main qi); stem weighted first (weights are mine; named convention, 三命通會's 歲用天元 reading is the alternative). Grade as the luck rule. Combine with the luck grade: both good = 'supported year'; luck bad and year bad = 'doubly bad'. The original 'halve the harm when luck is good' clause was not found in any source and is removed.
rules.template: The {year} year ({pillar}) brings {tenGodStem} (stem) and {tenGodBranch} (branch), {favourableOrNot} for this chart; the luck pillar is {luckGrade}.
rules.sourceCitation: 滴天髓闡微 歲運 (二十八); 淵海子平 論大運; 三命通會 卷二 總論歲運
rules.sourceLocator: 滴天髓闡微 二十八、歲運 (太歲管一年否泰…); 淵海子平 論大運 and 論太歲吉凶
rules.sourceQuote: 太歲管一年否泰，如所遇之人，故以天干為重，然地支不可不究
rules.variants: 三命通會: 歲用天元，運用地支 and the year is sovereign, the luck the minister (太歲如君也，大運如臣也): a clash between them is read for the sovereign first. 淵海子平: an obstructive year can be saved by a favourable luck. Expose both weightings.
rules.verificationNote: Topics restricted to general; unsourced harm-halving removed.

rules.name: 伏吟 and 反吟 (repeat and reversal) against the day pillar
rules.condition: 伏吟: a luck or year pillar identical (stem and branch) to the day pillar. 反吟: the period branch is the six-clash of the day branch AND the period stem is 4 or 6 places from the day stem in the ten-stem cycle (symmetric; the original's one-way list was wrong). Direction: unfavourable for topics relationships and wealth only (the source: harmful to kin and wealth); for other topics no sign. The branch half of 反吟 is the same fact as bazi.branch-chong on the day branch: dedupeKey shared. The programmed test is a convention; the source only says 相對 (opposite) and 壓 (pressing).
rules.template: The {periodName} {pillar} is a {fuOrFan} of the day pillar {dayPillar}.
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷二 總論歲運; 淵海子平 論大運
rules.sourceLocator: 卷二 總論歲運 (若歲運與日相對，謂之返吟，歲運壓日，謂之伏吟); 淵海子平 論大運 又一法
rules.sourceQuote: 若歲運與日相對，謂之返吟，歲運壓日，謂之伏吟，二者不利六親，非橫破財，不為吉兆。
rules.variants: 淵海子平 lists both as negative without defining them. Some schools also score 伏吟 on the month or year pillar.
rules.verificationNote: Stem test made symmetric; signs restricted to the topics the source names.

rules.name: Year and luck pillar the same (歲運並臨)
rules.condition: The year pillar equals the luck pillar (stem and branch). Default sign convention 'source-tengod' as the text gives it: if the pillar's ten god is 羊刃 or 七殺 the year is bad; if 財, 官 or 印 it is good; 比劫 and 食傷 are unsigned (direction activates). Optional convention 'xiji' signs by favourable element instead. The 'doubled' effect is NOT asserted (it is a gloss, not in the text). Note that for a strong self 七殺 may be favourable under 喜忌; the two conventions can disagree and the output names the one used.
rules.template: The year pillar repeats the luck pillar {pillar}, which is a {tenGod} for the day master: {goodOrBad} ({signConvention}).
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷二 論太歲
rules.sourceLocator: 卷二, 論太歲, third paragraph
rules.sourceQuote: 又如甲子流年又是甲子運，謂之歲運並臨，獨羊刃、七煞為凶，財、官、印綬亦吉。
rules.variants: Some modern schools use the term for any year whose stem and branch both equal the luck pillar's and judge by 喜忌, not ten god.
rules.verificationNote: Doubling dropped; sign convention named; unsigned gods stated.

rules.name: Heaven overcomes, earth clashes (天剋地沖) between luck and year
rules.condition: Between luck pillar P and year pillar Q: 天剋 if one stem overcomes the other; 地沖 if the branches are in the six-clash relation; 天剋地沖 when both occur. ORDER OF TESTS (single convention, 滴天髓): (1) if the day master is strong (旺相) -> no harm: emit direction activates, strength 1; (2) if the day master is not strong -> sign by whether the struck element is favourable (struck favourable = bad, struck unfavourable = good). The three readings of who strikes whom (運克歲 worse in 三命通會; 年沖運 吉 in 淵海子平) are NOT implemented; one named convention only.
rules.template: Luck {luck} and year {year} are in 天剋地沖: {striker} strikes {struck}; because {struckElement} is {favOrNot}, it is {goodOrBad}.
rules.sourceCitation: 滴天髓闡微 歲運 (二十八); 滴天髓輯要 歲運論 (何謂戰, 何謂衝); 三命通會 卷二 總論歲運
rules.sourceLocator: 滴天髓輯要 歲運論, subsections 何謂戰 and 何謂衝; 滴天髓闡微 二十八、歲運 (天克地衝); 三命通會 卷二 總論歲運
rules.sourceQuote: 最凶者天克地衝，歲運衝剋，日主旺相雖凶無礙，日主凶必罹凶咎。
rules.variants: 滴天髓 reads 'who yields' (降); 三命通會 says luck must not overcome or clash the year; 淵海子平 論大運 says the year clashing the luck is auspicious, luck overcoming the year inauspicious. Three readings, three possible conventions.
rules.verificationNote: Contradictory tests ordered; single reading kept.

rules.name: Day master against the year (日犯歲君 and 歲君犯日)
rules.condition: Year stem Q, day stem D. 日犯歲君: D overcomes Q (the year stem is the day master's 財). 歲君犯日: Q overcomes D (the year stem is its 官殺). SIGN IS CONDITIONAL (the fixed unfavourable sign contradicted the wealth and officer arrival rules): if the day master is strong (旺相) no harm: direction activates; if the day master is weak (休囚): unfavourable (日犯歲君 heavier than 歲君犯日 per the text). The topic-level sign of the same year belongs to bazi.wealth-star-in-luck and bazi.officer-star-in-luck; this rule emits only a 'general' flag and does not sign a topic. Rescue lists excluded.
rules.template: {dayStem} overcomes the year stem {yearStem}: the day master offends the year, which is {severity}.
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷二 論太歲; 淵海子平 論太歲吉凶, 論征太歲
rules.sourceLocator: 三命通會 卷二 論太歲, paragraph on 歲傷日干/日犯歲君; 淵海子平 論征太歲
rules.sourceQuote: 歲傷日干，有禍必輕；日犯歲君，災殃必重。
rules.variants: 三命通會: 日犯歲君 is heavy for a yang day stem (五陽干則重), light for a yin one (五陰干則輕). 滴天髓闡微: 日犯歲君，日主旺相無咎，日主休囚必凶 (strength-conditional, used here).
rules.verificationNote: Fixed sign made conditional on strength; topic signing left to the arrival rules.

rules.name: Day pillar combined with the year pillar (晦)
rules.condition: Fires only when BOTH the year stem combines with the day stem (甲己, 乙庚, 丙辛, 丁壬, 戊癸) AND the year branch forms a six-combination with the day branch (the source says 日干支 combined with 太歲干支). A stem-only or branch-only combination does NOT fire here (branch-only belongs to bazi.branch-liuhe). Direction unfavourable, strength 1, flag 晦 (delay, 一年反覆、欲速不達). The earlier statement that the sign depends on the combined element is dropped: the source states no condition.
rules.template: The year pillar {yearPillar} combines with the day pillar {dayPillar}: a year of delay (晦).
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論征太歲; 三命通會 卷二 論太歲
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論征太歲, last lines; 三命通會 卷二 論太歲 after 總論歲運
rules.sourceQuote: 日干支合太歲干支曰晦，歲運合歲干亦然；遇此者主晦氣，一年反覆、欲速不達。
rules.variants: 三命通會: harm is heavier when the year is five places ahead of the day (歲在日前五辰, 太歲入宅). Other schools read a day-year combination as a gain.
rules.verificationNote: Pillar-level test as the source states; stem-only firing removed.

rules.name: Six clashes (六沖) of an incoming branch with the natal branches
rules.condition: Pairs 子午, 丑未, 寅申, 卯酉, 辰戌, 巳亥. Test an incoming (luck or year) branch against each natal branch. On a clash, the TOPIC comes from bazi.pillar-palaces (struck palace). Direction by the MAIN QI of the struck branch (engine): favourable if that element is unfavourable (the clash removes it), unfavourable if it is favourable; 'activates' if the day master is balanced. The unseen claims (storehouse clashes 'delighted in'; clashes cancelled in a great structure) are held back. This single rule replaces the separate month-clash and day-clash rules; the 反吟 half on the day branch shares its dedupeKey.
rules.template: The {incoming} {periodName} clashes the natal {pillarName} branch {natalBranch} ({palaceMeaning}).
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷二 論衝擊
rules.sourceLocator: 卷二, 論衝擊
rules.sourceQuote: 地支取七位為沖，猶天干取七位為煞之義。如子午對沖，子至午七數
rules.variants: The source says a clash can be good: 破禍成福, 破福成禍; a month clashing the day or hour, or the hour clashing the year, is enmity (仇). Mapping a clash to a marriage or job event is a later convention.
rules.verificationNote: Direction defined by main qi; unseen clauses removed; month-clash and day-clash rules folded in.

rules.name: Six combinations (六合) of an incoming branch
rules.condition: Pairs 子丑, 寅亥, 卯戌, 辰酉, 巳申, 午未. If an incoming branch forms a six-combination with a natal branch flag 'combined' for that palace; topic from bazi.pillar-palaces. Direction 'activates' (bonding): the sign by combined element and the 合解沖 rule are NOT implemented because the 合化 elements are garbled/contested and the 合解沖 text was not seen. When the same branch is also in a clash the output lists both and signs neither.
rules.template: The {incoming} branch combines with the natal {pillarName} branch {natalBranch}, tying the {palaceMeaning}.
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷二 論支元六合
rules.sourceLocator: 卷二, 論支元六合
rules.variants: The researcher's quote 子寅辰午申戌六者為陽… was not found by the checker, so none is shown. 三命通會: a secret combination is better than an open one (明合不如暗合); 合祿, 合馬, 合貴. Whether a combination transforms the element is a school difference. 午未 is earth in one school and fire in another.
rules.verificationNote: Unverified quote removed; sign and 合化 held back.

rules.name: Three-harmony (三合) groups completed by an incoming branch
rules.condition: Groups 申子辰 water, 亥卯未 wood, 寅午戌 fire, 巳酉丑 metal. If the natal chart holds two of a group and the incoming branch is the third, flag 'group completed' with the group's element. A group missing one character does not transform (三命通會). Sign: favourable if the element is favourable, else unfavourable. The 三會 directional groups (寅卯辰 etc.) and the four-earth clause were not seen in the opened text and are held back.
rules.template: The incoming {incoming} completes the {groupName} group ({element}) with the natal {natalBranches}.
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷二 論支元三合
rules.sourceLocator: 卷二, 論支元三合
rules.sourceQuote: 若三字缺一則化不成局，不可以三合化局論。
rules.variants: Whether a complete group transforms the day master's judgement completely or only adds weight is a school difference. Many schools let a half-group count as half-strength.
rules.verificationNote: Id shortened from bazi.branch-sanhe-sanhui; 三會 part held back.

rules.name: Heavenly noble (天乙貴人)
rules.condition: Day stem to noble branches (tables.tianYiGuiRen). If a natal, luck or year branch equals a noble branch of the day stem, flag the star. A luck or year branch that equals one is a 'noble helper' period. Strength reduced if the branch is 空亡 or clashed.
rules.template: {branch} is the heavenly noble (天乙貴人) of the day stem {dayStem}.
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷三 論天乙貴人
rules.sourceLocator: 卷三, 論天乙貴人 (the 三車一覽 and 廣錄 explanations)
rules.sourceQuote: 甲陽木、戊陽土、庚陽金，皆喜土位。未者，土之正位；丑者，土安靜之地，所以牛羊為貴。
rules.variants: The text also records the 壺中子 school (day-born and night-born nobles, 晝貴 and 夜貴) and the 閻東叟 variant (by favourable element, excluded). Expose 'one set' versus 'day/night' as a named convention.

rules.name: Post-horse (驛馬)
rules.condition: By the year or day branch's three-harmony group (tables.yiMa). If a luck or year branch equals the horse branch of the natal year or day branch, flag a 'moving' period (travel, relocation, change of post). Also flag a natal horse. Activator of home-travel; sign by the favourable test, not by the star. A clash on the horse branch (破馬) removes its good.
rules.template: {incoming} is the post-horse of the natal {baseBranch}, which activates travel or relocation.
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷三 論驛馬
rules.sourceLocator: 卷三, 論驛馬
rules.sourceQuote: 寅午戌生人，馬在申而五陽干乘之。
rules.variants: Year branch versus day branch as the base is a school difference: the Song texts take the year, later practice the day first. 合馬 is a variant in 卷二 論支元六合.

rules.name: Peach blossom / bathing (桃花 or 咸池)
rules.condition: By the year or day branch's three-harmony group the 咸池 branch is as in tables.xianChiTaoHua (the second 長生 stage, 沐浴). If a luck or year branch equals it, flag the star as an activator of relationships. Direction 'activates', not a verdict (the source calls it a bad star, especially for a woman; modern practice adds charm).
rules.template: {incoming} is the peach-blossom (咸池) branch of the natal {baseBranch}, which activates relationships.
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷二 論咸池
rules.sourceLocator: 卷二, 論咸池
rules.sourceQuote: 寅午戌卯、已酉丑午、申子辰酉、亥卯未子即長生第二位沐浴之宮是也
rules.variants: The source calls the star a bad star and lists only harms; later and modern use also treats it as charm. A separate 紅艷煞 in 卷三 is a different table and is excluded.

rules.name: Blade (羊刃 or 陽刃)
rules.condition: Blade branch = the one after the 祿 branch for the five yang stems (tables.yangRen; 戊午 is named in the text). A natal branch equal to it is a natal blade; a luck or year branch equal to it activates the blade. Sign (the researcher's gloss; the text says 已極則為凶，成而未極則為福): unfavourable when the day master is strong and no 官殺 holds it; favourable when held by a 官殺 star (羊刃駕殺). Yin stems have no blade in the 子平 school (variant: 乙辰 丁未 辛戌 癸丑).
rules.template: {branch} is the blade (羊刃) of the {dayStem} day master, a period of excess or conflict.
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷三 論羊刃
rules.sourceLocator: 卷三, 論羊刃
rules.sourceQuote: 祿過則刃生；功成當退不退則過，越其分如羊之在刃，言有傷也。故羊刃常居祿前一辰。
rules.variants: The 'extreme position' list gives the yin stems their own positions; the 子平 school gives the blade to the five yang stems only (子平以甲丙戊庚壬五陽干有刃).

rules.name: Lu-spirit (祿神)
rules.condition: The 祿 branch of each day stem (tables.luShen). A natal, luck or year branch equal to it is flagged. A luck or year branch equal to the 祿 branch activates wealth and career ('salary': a gloss of the researcher). The four storehouse branches have no 祿.
rules.template: {branch} is the 祿 of the {dayStem} day master, a period of income and standing.
rules.sourceCitation: 三命通會 卷三 論十干祿
rules.sourceLocator: 卷三, 論十干祿 (opening paragraph)
rules.sourceQuote: 所以甲祿寅，乙祿卯，庚祿申，辛祿酉，壬祿亥，癸祿子，丙祿已，丁祿午，戊寄已，已寄午
rules.variants: A school gives 戊 祿 寅; not in the text read. The pillar-level fortune claims (甲寅 'long-life 祿', 庚寅 'broken 祿') are excluded. 建祿 as a month structure is a separate 子平真詮 topic.

rules.name: Wealth star arrives in a luck pillar or year
rules.condition: Stem or MAIN-QI hidden stem (engine) of the luck pillar or year is 正財 or 偏財. If the 財 element is favourable and bazi.topic-wealth-promise is not 'absent': favourable (wealth period). If unfavourable, or natal 財 is 'robbed' or 'too heavy': unfavourable. 食傷 arriving beside a favourable 財 strengthens the source. Strength 3 if stem and branch are both 財, 2 if only the branch, 1 if only the stem (mine). This owns the wealth topic for the span; bazi.luck-pillar-judgement and bazi.year-judgement do not fire for wealth.
rules.template: The {periodName} {pillar} brings {tenGod} (財) in a {favOrNot} element: a {goodOrBad} period for wealth.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論大運; 滴天髓闡微 歲運
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論大運, list of luck by ten god; 滴天髓闡微 二十八
rules.sourceQuote: 辰戌丑未戊己財運，主名利皆通。此乃死法譬喻，須隨格局喜忌推之，不可執一
rules.variants: 淵海子平 gives 'for 甲, earth luck brings fame and profit' and at once calls it a dead rule to be read by likes and dislikes, so the sign depends on the favourable element, not on the ten god.
rules.verificationNote: Main-qi fix; single scoring path declared.

rules.name: Officer or Seven-Killings star arrives in a luck pillar or year
rules.condition: Stem or MAIN-QI hidden stem of the luck pillar or year is 正官 or 七殺. If the 官殺 element is favourable and the natal career grade is not 'mixed' or 'overpowering': favourable career period. If unfavourable, or the arrival creates 官殺混雜 (the other of 正官 and 七殺 already in the chart): unfavourable. For a woman (husband-star convention) the same arrival also fires relationships, deduped against bazi.topic-spouse-woman. Owns the career topic for the span.
rules.template: The {periodName} {pillar} brings {tenGod} (官殺) in a {favOrNot} element: a {goodOrBad} period for career{womanNote}.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論大運; 論官殺混雜要制伏
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論大運: 庚辛申酉七殺官鄉，主得名，發越太過，則災病惡疾
rules.sourceQuote: 庚辛申酉七殺官鄉，主得名，發越太過，則災病惡疾
rules.variants: The source warns fame can be too much (the 'overpowering' branch). 任鐵樵: a strong self treats 殺 as 官, a weak self treats 官 as 殺.
rules.verificationNote: Main-qi fix; de-duplication declared.

rules.name: Resource (印) arrives in a luck pillar or year
rules.condition: Stem or main-qi hidden stem of the luck pillar or year is 正印 or 偏印. If the 印 element is favourable (day master weak): good for learning, support and recovery. If unfavourable (day master strong): excess, delay, idleness. The 倒食 clause (偏印 over a natal 食神) was not confirmed and is removed. Owns learning for the span.
rules.template: The {periodName} {pillar} brings {tenGod} (印) in a {favOrNot} element: a {goodOrBad} period for learning and support.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論大運
rules.sourceLocator: 論大運: 行壬癸亥子生氣印綬運，主吉慶增產
rules.sourceQuote: 行壬癸亥子生氣印綬運，主吉慶增產
rules.variants: The source calls the list a dead rule for 甲 and tells the reader to read by likes and dislikes.
rules.verificationNote: Confirmed; unconfirmed 倒食 clause removed.

rules.name: Output (食傷) arrives in a luck pillar or year
rules.condition: Stem or main-qi hidden stem of the luck pillar or year is 食神 or 傷官. If the element is favourable (strong day master): productive. If unfavourable (weak day master): drains the self. 傷官 arriving beside an existing 正官 is 傷官見官 (unfavourable for a woman's marriage). The extensions 'for a man's career' and 傷官生財 favourable if strong were not found in the text and are removed. Sign by 喜忌 as the source instructs.
rules.template: The {periodName} {pillar} brings {tenGod} (食傷) in a {favOrNot} element: {outputNote}.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論大運, 論傷官, 論婦人總訣
rules.sourceLocator: 論大運: 行丙丁巳午運，名傷官，主剋子女、訟事、囚繫; 論婦人總訣 (傷官見官，為禍百端)
rules.sourceQuote: 傷官見官，為禍百端
rules.variants: The source gives 傷官 luck as harming children, lawsuits, imprisonment for a 甲 day, and calls it a dead rule to be read against likes and dislikes. The 格局 school reads 傷官配印 as good and 傷官見官 as bad. The researcher's quote 傷官見官，剋夫再嫁、身心勞役 was not found and is replaced by the line the checker saw.
rules.verificationNote: Quote replaced by the line seen; unsupported extensions removed.

rules.name: Peers (比劫) arrive in a luck pillar or year
rules.condition: Stem or main-qi hidden stem of the luck pillar or year is 比肩 or 劫財. If the element is favourable (weak day master): supportive. If unfavourable (strong day master) with 財 present in the chart: 'rivalry for wealth', loss or competition. 劫財 over a natal 正財 is a wealth loss. The extra clause 'a man with many 劫財 harms the wife' was not seen and is removed.
rules.template: The {periodName} {pillar} brings {tenGod} (比劫) in a {favOrNot} element: {peerNote}.
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論大運, 論劫財
rules.sourceLocator: 論大運: 甲乙得寅卯運，名曰劫財敗財，主剋父母及剋妻、破財爭鬥之事
rules.sourceQuote: 甲乙得寅卯運，名曰劫財敗財，主剋父母及剋妻、破財爭鬥之事
rules.variants: The source reads this as a harm for any 甲乙 day and then qualifies it by 'read by likes and dislikes'.
rules.verificationNote: Confirmed; unseen clause removed. Shares dedupeKey with wealth-star-in-luck: the stronger counts once.

rules.name: Natal spouse palace: the day branch (router only)
rules.condition: Router, not an independent firing. Records that the day branch is the spouse palace and that 日坐空亡 is flagged. Any incoming clash, harm, punishment or combination to the day branch is scored ONLY by bazi.branch-chong, bazi.branch-liuhe (and held-back harm and punishment) and routed to relationships through bazi.pillar-palaces. For a man the test also records whether the arrival brings 財 (bazi.topic-spouse-man); for a woman, 官殺. Mapping an incoming relation to a marriage event is a later convention and is not asserted.
rules.template: The day branch {dayBranch} is the spouse palace ({note}).
rules.sourceCitation: 淵海子平 論妻妾; 論婦人總訣
rules.sourceLocator: 淵海子平 論妻妾 (日下月下坐財官…日坐空亡，難為妻妾)
rules.sourceQuote: 日下月下坐財官，主妻多內助，更得妻財。
rules.variants: The quotes concern the natal spouse palace, not an incoming clash. Schools that read the spouse from the 官星 or 財星 only reject the palace route. The fixed day-pillar lists (孤鸞, 陰錯陽差) are excluded.
rules.verificationNote: Reduced to a router; duplicates of branch-chong, liuhe, xing, hai removed.
